topic: AC compressor clutch not engaging — low-pressure cutoff switch
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.vo: Your AC blows warm. You assume it's just low on Freon.
beats.visualPrompt: Static shot inside a parked car on a hot sunny day, dashboard air vents in close-up blasting visible heat-shimmer air, sun glare through the windshield, warm color grade, shallow depth of field, cinematic automotive macro, 9:16 vertical.

beats.vo: But if the compressor clutch never engages, adding more refrigerant won't fix a thing.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up macro shot under the hood of a car: serpentine belt and AC compressor pulley, the pulley spinning but the center clutch plate not engaging, metallic reflections, daylight, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical.

beats.vo: A low-pressure cutoff switch can shut the compressor off on purpose, to protect it from running dry.
beats.visualPrompt: Extreme macro shot of a small AC low-pressure cutoff switch mounted on a refrigerant line under the hood, condensation beads on the metal line, cool blue-tinted highlights against a warm engine bay, 9:16 vertical.

beats.vo: A low gauge reading alone can point to a leak, or a switch doing exactly what it's built to do.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro shot of an automotive AC gauge manifold, analog dial needles, low-side gauge needle resting near the low end, hoses connected to a service port, garage bay lighting, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical.

beats.vo: That's one clue worth checking, not a diagnosis you make from the driver's seat.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide shot of a car raised on a hydraulic lift inside a clean auto repair bay, a diagnostic scan tool cable connected near the dash, bay lighting, no people in frame, 9:16 vertical.

beats.vo: Stop by and we'll take a look before you add anything to the system.
beats.visualPrompt: Exterior static shot of a tire and auto repair shop storefront in late-afternoon light, signage visible, parked cars in the lot, warm inviting color grade, 9:16 vertical.
